algorithm_core_comparison: Original 45 sampling/modeling files hash-identical; paired/event and spatial RNG loops compared exactly.
limitations: Published pool_ids.csv is the saved sampled modeling pool, not every eligible raster cell in the candidate domain. Candidate-cell masks remain private inputs/outputs.
Historical original NS2 full-positive-IV and independent-negative-split intermediate models are deliberately excluded; only final v4 runs are mapped.
Training scorer-ID separation does not prove spatial independence or validate all factor acquisition dates.
Original source is unlicensed; public open-source authorization and data permissions remain pending.
DTF/DTR/DTW English expansions are not established by filenames alone; authors must verify the factor semantic mapping.
